snippet.title: Dune: Awakening - PlayStation Gameplay | PS5
snippet.description:
Watch 7 minutes of Dune: Awakening gameplay on PlayStation 5, including a look at the full single-player experience.

Dune: Awakening launches on Playstation and XBOX on September 22

See how you can customize your single-player experience, create your character, survive your first days on Arrakis, gather resources, build your first shelter, explore the desert, fight enemies, and more.

Deluxe and Ultimate Edition owners can get a head start on September 17.
